      - and:
        - number: 0x5A827999 = K(t) (0 <= t <= 19), also used in RIPEMD-128, RIPEMD-160, RIPEMD-256, and RIPEMD-320
        - number: 0x6ED9EBA1 = K(t) (20 <= t <= 39), also used in RIPEMD-128, RIPEMD-160, RIPEMD-256, and RIPEMD-320
